Keeps the newest articles and every star. Enables retention on future refreshes for existing feeds. This cannot be undone; older articles may no longer be available from the feed server.

plurals.name: settings_retention_note
plurals.item: New feeds keep the newest %1$d unstarred article on refresh. Starred articles are always kept in addition to this limit. Existing feeds stay exempt until you apply the limit. Changing this setting alone deletes nothing; feeds already using retention adopt it on their next refresh. Removing a feed deletes all of its articles, including stars.

New feeds keep the newest %1$d unstarred articles on refresh. Starred articles are always kept in addition to this limit. Existing feeds stay exempt until you apply the limit. Changing this setting alone deletes nothing; feeds already using retention adopt it on their next refresh. Removing a feed deletes all of its articles, including stars.

resources.string: Checks your feeds when you open the app, at most every 15 minutes. Turn off to refresh only when you ask.
Dates use your device’s locale and time zone. Articles without dates show “Date unavailable” and follow dated articles when sorting by date.
Feed text, read status, stars, and subscriptions are stored on this device and remain available offline. This is your library, not a temporary cache.

Feed downloads bypass the HTTP cache and use server validators to avoid unchanged downloads. Reader images are off by default. Images you allow use temporary memory only; leaving an article or backgrounding the app revokes permission. The article reader uses nonpersistent storage. There is no persistent image cache to clear.
Feed URLs and titles, downloaded articles, read and starred status, and refresh metadata are stored locally. OPML import and export read or write the subscription files you choose.

Adding or refreshing a feed sends requests to its server, which receives the requested URL and connection information such as your IP address. The in-app reader displays text and basic formatting with remote content blocked by default. If you choose Load images for an article, image servers and their redirects may receive your IP address and image URLs. This temporary image permission resets when you leave the article, switch articles, hide images or move the app out of the foreground. Scripts, frames, publisher styles, fonts and media remain blocked. Images use a temporary downloader without saved cookies, credentials or cache; the reader uses nonpersistent website storage.

Opening an article or tapped link uses the destination service. Exporting OPML creates a copy of your feed list at the destination you choose. Feed providers, websites and file providers apply their own policies.

Deleting a feed removes its saved articles, including read and starred status. It does not erase information already held by publishers, exported OPML files or data in your external browser. The in-app reader does not retain persistent website cookies or cache. Deleting the app removes local app storage; backups and external copies are separate.

This version contains no developer-run analytics, advertising or account service. Device backups and services you choose, such as sharing destinations or file providers, follow their own settings and policies.

Send Feedback opens a draft in your email app or the contact form in your browser. The email draft includes the app version, Android version and device model. Your feeds and articles are not included. Nothing is sent unless you send it.

Contact opens our website. We use the name, email address and message you provide to respond to your request. Service providers may process this correspondence for us. We retain it as needed to resolve the request or meet legal obligations. Use the same contact form to request deletion.

Found a problem or have an idea? Report a bug and Request a feature open a draft in your email app, addressed to Plain Text Office, with your app version, Android version and device model filled in. Open contact form opens the contact form in your browser. Nothing is sent unless you send it.
For a bug, include what you did, what happened, and the feed address if one is involved.
No email app is available on this device. Use Open contact form instead.
No browser is available to open the contact form. Use Report a bug or Request a feature to write an email instead.
Plain RSS couldn’t open your saved feed library. Your existing data file has been left untouched.
Choose Retry to try opening it again, or Continue Without Saving to use temporary memory for this session.
